scope: Only atelier-art-course-2/main. The separate atelier-art-course repository was not read or modified.
implementation: Added a separate offline Tool Capability Engine with 19 tool categories, tool-combination interpretation, minimum-kit guidance, alternatives, and course references.
Added module-aware answers for Modules 2 and 3 and explicit prerequisite/skip guidance.
Added Devanagari-to-Latin transliteration to improve Hindi and Hinglish retrieval, plus edge-apostrophe token cleanup.
Improved current-lesson answers to select core ideas, mistakes, pro tips, practice steps, or rationale based on the question.
Added scored BM25 curriculum evidence retrieval and exact module-title metadata boosting.
Added a no-key public Wikipedia Action API fallback for questions not confidently answered locally; query text is bounded and email/URL/phone-like inputs are not sent.
Updated the Doubt Solver welcome copy to disclose external Wikipedia search and warn users not to include private information.
interpretation: The 100% figure means each existing QA prompt produced a BM25 result above the configured threshold; it does not mean every answer was semantically verified. Top retrieved module matched the dataset label for 98.3% of prompts. The remaining 27 mismatches are retained as visible audit examples in the reproducible corpus audit.
limitations: This is deterministic retrieval and rule-based answer construction, not a generative reasoning model.
The external fallback is Wikipedia search, not a full-web search engine; it returns short sourced extracts and may return no result.
External search was tested with mocked API responses. Browser CORS support is documented by MediaWiki, but a deployed-browser end-to-end request was not verified in this run.
The existing 1,551-prompt QA dataset is English-only; bilingual coverage comes from the new 57-case regression suite, not from the existing corpus.
